claimBoundary: This cycle audits released posterior samples. It does not rerun DESI clustering, CMB mapmaking, supernova light-curve calibration, or the local distance ladder.

externalStateCheck.reasonNotPooled: The current Dovekie chain changes supernova calibration and processing and uses a Planck+ACT+SPT CMB combination, so it is a temporal external check rather than a one-variable likelihood substitution.

localLadder.source: Riess et al. 2024 HST full ladder summary

predeclaredGates.sourceIntegrity: Every official chain SHA-256 must match the DESI checksum manifest; the Dovekie file must be pinned to the declared commit and Git blob.
predeclaredGates.physicalRulerConflict: For each default-CMB supernova family, the CMB-chain rdrag minus the locally required rdrag must exceed zero by at least three propagated posterior standard deviations to retain the early-ruler bottleneck.
predeclaredGates.stateChange: Dovekie is reported separately. A shift in w0-wa is evidence that the original DES-SN5YR conclusion is release-sensitive, not proof that calibration alone caused the shift.

anchors: SMC detached eclipsing binaries when eligible
localAnchorAuditContract.pass: No omitted branch shifts H0 by one full posterior sigma, residuals do not align with a photometric-system boundary, and a held implementation reproduces the covariance-aware result.
localAnchorAuditContract.stop: Stop physical-model enlargement if one rung dominates or if the held implementation cannot reproduce the released baseline.
